name: supine spinal twist yoga pose
description: A relaxing lying twist that mobilises the spine and stretches the hips and sides of the trunk.
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Guide that knee across your body toward the floor on the opposite side.
Keep both shoulders on the floor and turn your head the other way if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
